entries.name: Activation Order
entries.subtitle: Alternating activations

blocks.t: Players alternate **activating a single character** — the first player activates a character, then the second player activates one, and so on. A character that has activated is flipped to its **exhausted** side and can't activate again until the next round.

When all characters on the table have activated, the round ends and players alternate choosing which **First Player** for the next round (the player who went second last round chooses who goes first next round).

entries.name: Power
entries.subtitle: The resource of the game

blocks.t: Characters gain **Power** as the game goes on: **1 power** at the start of each activation, **1 power** each time they're damaged, and **1 power** when an enemy throws a friendly character they're adjacent to.

Power is spent on **superpowers** (the character's action cards — big attacks, buffs, and utility) and to **play tactics cards**. A character can bank as much power as the card allows — excess is lost.

entries.name: Actions
entries.subtitle: Move, attack, and interact

blocks.t: On a character's activation you may take **one or two actions** (how many depends on the character's card — most get two). The standard actions are **Move**, **Attack**, **Shove**, **Throw**, **Grab**, and **Interact** (with objectives or terrain).

**Move** lets a character use its Speed (Long then Medium then Short distances — e.g. Speed 4 moves up to 4 Small moves). A character can't end a move overlapping another character or in base contact with an enemy unless it's moving to engage.

entries.name: Attacks & Damage
entries.subtitle: Dice, crits, and damage

blocks.t: An attack rolls a pool of **dice equal to the attacker's attack value** (Physical, Energy, or Power depending on the attack). A **crit** counts as two successes. The defender rolls dice equal to its **defense value** of the matching type; a **wild** (blank with a star) cancels one attacker success.

Damage dealt equals the attacker's **remaining successes** (minimum 1). Damage reduces the defender's **Wound Threshold**: when wounds equal the threshold the character is **KO'd** — remove it from the table and the controlling player gains **1 VP**.

entries.name: Throws
entries.subtitle: Hurl enemies into scenery

blocks.t: A character with the **Throw** power can spend an action to grab an adjacent smaller character and hurl it up to its own Speed. The thrown character suffers damage if it lands on terrain or another character, and both it and anything it hits can be damaged or **stunned**.
Throwing an enemy into a **vulnerable terrain** piece (like a car or dumpster) is a classic play: the target takes damage and the terrain is destroyed, often clearing an objective or denying cover.

entries.name: Conditions
entries.subtitle: Staggered, Poisoned, Shocked & more

rows: Gains no power from being damaged until it's cleared.
Loses 1 power at the start of its activation.
Can't take actions; automatically cleared at the end of its activation.
Must attack its own team if able.
Takes 1 damage at the start of each activation until healed.

entries.name: Victory Conditions
entries.subtitle: Winning the game

blocks.t: Players earn **Victory Points** for scoring **objectives** (controlled at the end of each round), **KO'ing** enemy characters, and completing **crisis cards** (the scenario chosen before the game). The game ends after a set number of rounds (usually 6).
The player with the **most Victory Points** wins. In the event of a tie, players compare: total enemy characters KO'd, then total enemy damage dealt, then a roll-off.
